releases.author: steipete
releases.summary:
### Highlights

- Plugins/file-transfer: add bundled file-transfer plugin with `file_fetch`, `dir_list`, `dir_fetch`, and `file_write` agent tools for binary file ops on paired nodes; default-deny per-node path policy under `plugins.entries.file-transfer.config.nodes` with operator approval, symlink traversal refused by default (opt-in `followSymlinks`), and a 16 MB byte ceiling per round-trip. (#74742) Thanks @omarshahine.
- Plugins/install: harden official plugin install, uninstall, update, onboarding, ClawHub fallback, npm dependency-state reporting, and beta-channel update paths so externalized plugins behave like first-class package installs.
- Gateway/performance: trim startup and Control UI hot paths by lazy-loading plugin/runtime discovery, cron, schema, shutdown, sessions, and model metadata work only when needed.
- Channels/replies: improve Discord status reactions and degraded transport reporting, add WhatsApp Channel/Newsletter targets, and tighten Telegram, Feishu, Matrix, Microsoft Teams, and Slack delivery/recovery behavior.
- Install/update: recover broken macOS LaunchAgent upgrades, reject source-only plugin packages before runtime load, and repair stale Gateway/plugin state during updates and doctor runs.
- Agent/runtime reliability: preserve streamed provider replies, delayed A2A session replies, prompt/tool delivery, memory recall, web search provider discovery, and provider-specific thinking/model metadata across common edge cases.

### Changes

- Channels/streaming: add unified `streaming.mode: "progress"` drafts with auto single-word status labels and shared progress configuration across Discord, Telegram, Matrix, Slack, and Microsoft Teams.
- Agents/commands: add `/steer <message>` for queue-independent steering of the active current-session run without starting a new turn when the session is idle. (#76934)
- Tools/BTW: add `/side` as a text and native slash-command alias for `/btw` side questions.
- Doctor/config: `doctor --fix` now commits safe legacy migrations even when unrelated validation issues (e.g. a missing plugin) prevent full validation from passing, so `agents.defaults.llm` and other known-legacy keys are always cleaned up by `doctor --fix` regardless of other config problems. Fixes #76798. (#76800) Thanks @hclsys.
- Agents/tools: skip optional media and PDF tool factories when the effective tool denylist already blocks them, avoiding unnecessary hot-path setup for tools that will be filtered out before model use. (#76773) Thanks @dorukardahan.
- Discord/status: let explicit reaction tool calls opt into tracking subsequent tool progress on the reacted message with `trackToolCalls: true`, and use the shared tool display emoji table for status reactions.
- Gateway/config: stop Gateway startup and hot reload from auto-restoring invalid config; invalid config now fails closed and `openclaw doctor --fix` owns last-known-good repair.
- Gateway/performance: lazy-load early runtime discovery and shutdown-hook helpers, defer maintenance timers until after readiness, and trim duplicate plugin auto-enable work during Gateway startup.
- QA/Mantis: add a `pnpm openclaw qa mantis discord-smoke` runner and manual GitHub workflow that verify the Mantis Discord bot can see the configured guild/channel, post a smoke message, add a reaction, and upload artifacts.
- QA/Slack: add a Slack live transport QA runner with canary and mention-gating coverage for the private bot-to-bot harness. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Plugins/onboarding: let Manual setup install optional official plugins, including ClawHub-backed diagnostics with npm fallback, and expose the external Codex plugin as a selectable provider setup choice. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Plugins/CLI/update: include package dependency install state in `openclaw plugins list --json`, trust official externalized npm migrations, clean stale bundled load paths for externalized installs, try plugin `@beta` updates first on the beta OpenClaw channel, and fall back to default/latest when no plugin beta release exists.
- Plugins/ClawHub: annotate 429 errors with reset windows and unauthenticated higher-rate-limit hints, so operators can tell when downloads recover and when signing in helps. Thanks @romneyda.
- Gateway/performance: lazy-load early runtime discovery, shutdown hooks, cron, channel-config schema metadata, restart sentinels, and maintenance timers after readiness; trim duplicate plugin auto-enable work and add startup CPU/profile controls.
- Gateway/config: stop Gateway startup and hot reload from auto-restoring invalid config; invalid config now fails closed and `openclaw doctor --fix` owns last-known-good repair.
- Discord/status: let explicit reaction tool calls opt into tracking later tool progress with `trackToolCalls: true`, share tool display emoji mapping, and surface degraded Discord transport or gateway event-loop starvation in status output. (#76327) Thanks @joshavant.
- Channels/WhatsApp: support explicit WhatsApp Channel/Newsletter `@newsletter` outbound message targets with channel session metadata instead of DM routing. Fixes #13417; carries forward the narrow outbound target idea from #13424. Thanks @vincentkoc and @agentz-manfred.
- Agents/tools: skip optional media and PDF tool factories when the effective tool denylist already blocks them, avoiding unnecessary hot-path setup for tools that will be filtered out before model use. (#76773) Thanks @dorukardahan.
- Agents/sandbox: store sandbox container and browser registry entries as per-runtime shard files, reducing unrelated session lock contention while `openclaw doctor --fix` migrates legacy monolithic registry files. (#74831) Thanks @luckylhb90.
- Tools/BTW: add `/side` as a text and native slash-command alias for `/btw` side questions.
- Exec approvals: add a tree-sitter-backed shell command explainer for future approval and command-review surfaces. (#75004) Thanks @jesse-merhi.
- QA/Mantis: add a `pnpm openclaw qa mantis discord-smoke` runner and manual GitHub workflow that verify the Mantis Discord bot can see the configured guild/channel, post a smoke message, add a reaction, and upload artifacts.

### Fixes

- Channels/WhatsApp: allow `@whiskeysockets/libsignal-node` in `onlyBuiltDependencies` so pnpm v9+ `blockExoticSubdeps` no longer rejects the baileys git-tarball subdep and silences all inbound agent replies. Fixes #76539. Thanks @ottodeng and @vincentkoc.
- Gateway/systemd: preserve operator-added secrets in the Gateway env file across re-stage while clearing OpenClaw-managed keys (such as `OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN`) so a fresh staging value is never shadowed by a stale env-file copy; operator secrets are also retained when the state-dir `.env` is empty. Fixes #76860. Thanks @hclsys.
- Plugin updates: do not short-circuit trusted official npm updates as unchanged when the default/latest spec still resolves to an already-installed prerelease that the installer should replace with a stable fallback. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Plugin tools: keep auth-unavailable optional tools hidden even when another default tool from the same plugin is available and `tools.alsoAllow` names the optional tool. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Realtime transcription: report socket closes before provider readiness as closed-before-ready failures instead of mislabeling them as connection timeouts for OpenAI, xAI, and Deepgram streaming transcription. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- OpenAI/Google Meet: fail realtime voice connection attempts when the socket closes before `session.updated`, avoiding stuck Meet joins waiting on a bridge that never became ready. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- QA/cache: require the full `CACHE-OK <suffix>` marker before live cache probes stop retrying, so suffix-only prose cannot hide a broken probe response. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Slack/Matrix: avoid creating blank progress-draft messages when `streaming.progress.label=false` and progress tool lines are disabled. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- QA/Matrix: keep the mock OpenAI tool-progress provider aligned with exact-marker Matrix prompts so the hardened live preview scenario still forces a deterministic read before final delivery. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- OpenAI/Google Meet: wait for realtime voice `session.updated` before treating the bridge as connected, so Meet joins do not return with audio queued behind an unconfigured realtime session. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Plugins/catalog: merge official external catalog descriptors into partial package channel config metadata, so lagging WeCom/Yuanbao manifests keep their own schema while still exposing host-supplied labels and setup text. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Plugins/catalog: supplement lagging official external WeCom and Yuanbao npm manifests with channel config descriptors and declared tool contracts from the OpenClaw catalog, so trusted package sweeps no longer fail because external package metadata trails the host contract. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Plugins/install: let trusted official `@openclaw/*` catalog installs recover when npm `latest` points at a prerelease by falling back to the newest stable version, or by selecting the newest exact prerelease for prerelease-only launch packages with a warning instead of making beta/development plugin sweeps fail at install time. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Google Meet: grant Chrome media permissions against the actual Meet tab, start the local realtime audio bridge only after Meet joins, expose realtime transcripts in status/logs, and force explicit audio responses with current OpenAI realtime output-audio events so BlackHole capture does not keep the OpenClaw participant muted or silent.
- Memory/LanceDB: declare `apache-arrow` in the bundled memory plugin package so LanceDB installs include its runtime peer. Fixes #76910. Thanks @afiqfiles-max.
- CLI/devices: retry explicit device-pair approval with `operator.admin` after a pairing-scope ownership denial, so existing admin-capable paired-device tokens can recover new Control UI/browser pairing after upgrades instead of requiring manual JSON edits. Fixes #76956. Thanks @neo19482.
- Google Meet: use the local call-control microphone button instead of disabled remote participant mute buttons, and block realtime speech when the OpenClaw Meet microphone remains muted.
- Google Meet: refresh realtime browser state during status and retry delayed speech after Meet finishes joining, so a just-opened in-call tab no longer leaves speech stuck behind stale `not-in-call` health.
- Plugins/install: recover the install ledger from the managed npm root when `plugins/installs.json` is empty or partial, so reinstalling Discord and Codex no longer makes the other installed plugin disappear.
- Google Meet: grant Meet media permissions through the Playwright browser context when CDP grants do not affect the attached Chrome page, and report in-call microphone/speaker permission problems instead of marking realtime speech ready.
- QA/Slack: fail the live mention-gating scenario on any unexpected SUT reply, even when the reply does not echo the expected marker. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- QA/Matrix: steer the live tool-progress preview check away from `HEARTBEAT.md` and report final preview candidates when the live marker reply misses the exact token. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- QA/Matrix: let the live tool-progress preview check verify progress replacement events without depending on the preview saying `Working`. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Tlon: expose `groupInviteAllowlist` in the channel config schema and clarify that group invite auto-accept fails closed without an invite allowlist. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Control UI/WebChat: collapse duplicate in-flight internal text sends onto the active Gateway run so rapid repeat submits do not start fresh `agent:main:main` dispatches. Fixes #75737. Thanks @dsdsddd1 and @BunsDev.
- Mattermost: accept the documented `channels.mattermost.streaming` config and honor `streaming: "off"` by disabling draft preview posts. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Mattermost: expose streaming progress config labels and help text in generated channel config metadata so Control UI/docs can explain the new `channels.mattermost.streaming.progress.*` fields. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Mattermost: honor `channels.mattermost.streaming.progress.toolProgress=false` in progress draft mode so compact tool status lines stay hidden until final delivery. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Microsoft Teams: honor progress draft tool lines in native Teams progress streams and suppress standalone tool messages when `channels.msteams.streaming.progress.toolProgress=false`. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Discord: keep progress draft boundary callbacks bound during streaming replies, so extension lint stays green while progress previews transition between assistant and reasoning blocks. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Discord: resolve SecretRef-backed bot tokens from the active runtime snapshot for named accounts and keep unresolved configured tokens from crashing status or health checks. (#76987) Thanks @joshavant.
- Channels/streaming: expose `streaming.progress.label`, `labels`, `maxLines`, and `toolProgress` in bundled channel config metadata so progress draft settings appear in config, docs, and control surfaces. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Channels/streaming: normalize whitespace and case for `streaming.progress.label: "auto"` so progress draft labels keep using the built-in label pool instead of rendering a literal `auto` title. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Plugins/Codex: preserve Codex-native OAuth routing for `/codex bind` app-server turns so bound sessions keep the selected Codex auth profile instead of falling back to public OpenAI credentials. (#76714) Thanks @keshavbotagent.
- Gateway/install: prefer supported system Node over nvm/fnm/volta/asdf/mise when regenerating managed gateway services, so `gateway install --force` no longer recreates service definitions that doctor immediately flags as version-manager-backed. Fixes #76339. Thanks @brokemac79.
- Cron/status: render explicit `delivery.mode: "none"` jobs as no-delivery previews and label cron session history distinctly instead of showing fallback delivery or direct-session rows. Fixes #76945.
- Gateway/usage: serve `usage.cost` and `sessions.usage` from a durable transcript aggregate cache with lock-safe background refreshes and localized stale-cache status, so large usage views avoid repeated full scans. (#76650) Thanks @Marvinthebored.
- Plugins/hooks: let `plugins.entries.<id>.hooks.timeoutMs` and `plugins.entries.<id>.hooks.timeouts` bound plugin typed hooks from operator config, so slow hooks can be tuned without patching installed plugin code. Fixes #76778. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Telegram: add `channels.telegram.mediaGroupFlushMs` at the top level and per account so operators can tune album buffering instead of being stuck with the hard-coded 500ms media-group flush window. Fixes #76149. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Config/messages: coerce boolean `messages.visibleReplies` and `messages.groupChat.visibleReplies` values to the documented enum modes so an intuitive toggle no longer invalidates config and drops channel startup. Fixes #75390. Thanks @scottgl9.
- Agents/network: allow trusted web-search providers and configured model-provider hosts to work behind Surge/Clash/sing-box fake-IP DNS by accepting RFC 2544 and IPv6 ULA synthetic answers only for the request's scoped hostname, without broad private-network access. Refs #76530 and #76549. Thanks @zqchris.
- Providers: honor env-proxy settings for guarded provider model fetches when no explicit dispatcher policy is configured, preserving explicit transport overrides. Fixes #70453. (#72480) Thanks @mjamiv.
- Web fetch: add a default-off `tools.web.fetch.useTrustedEnvProxy` opt-in for proxy-only environments so `web_fetch` can let an operator-controlled HTTP(S) proxy resolve DNS while preserving default strict DNS pinning and hostname policy checks. Refs #58034 and #62560. Thanks @cosmicnet and @mjamiv.
- Feishu: accept and honor `channels.feishu.blockStreaming` at the top level and per account, while keeping the legacy default off so Feishu cards no longer reject documented config or silently drop block replies. Fixes #75555. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Gateway/update: avoid `launchctl kickstart -k` immediately after fresh macOS update bootstraps, and unlink dangling global plugin-runtime symlinks during packaged postinstall and `doctor --fix` so upgrades no longer SIGTERM the newly booted Gateway or leave bundled plugin imports pointed at pruned `plugin-runtime-deps` trees. Completes #76261 and fixes #76466. (#76929)
- Google Chat: normalize custom Google auth transport headers before google-auth/gaxios interceptors run, restoring webhook token verification when certificate retrieval expects Fetch `Headers`. Fixes #76742. Thanks @donbowman.
- Doctor/plugins: reset stale `plugins.slots.memory` and `plugins.slots.contextEngine` references during `doctor --fix`, so cleanup of missing plugin config does not leave unrecoverable slot owners behind. Fixes #76550 and #76551. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Docs/WhatsApp: merge the duplicate top-level `web` objects in the gateway channel config example so copy-pasted WhatsApp config keeps both `web.whatsapp` and reconnect settings. Fixes #76619. Thanks @WadydX.
- Plugins/Anthropic: expose Claude thinking profiles from the bundled provider-policy artifact so non-runtime callers keep Opus 4.7 `adaptive`, `xhigh`, and `max` instead of downgrading to `high`. Fixes #76779. Thanks @tomascupr and @iAbhi001.
- Plugins/tools: honor `tools.alsoAllow` as an optional plugin tool discovery hint without treating its internal allow-all default as permission to load every manifest-marked optional plugin tool. Fixes #76616.
- Discord/native commands: skip slash-command registration and cleanup REST calls when `channels.discord.commands.native=false`, letting low-power gateways start without waiting on disabled native-command lifecycle requests. Fixes #76202. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- CLI/plugins: reject unowned command roots such as `openclaw foo` before managed proxy startup and full plugin CLI runtime loading while preserving manifest-owned and CLI-metadata-owned plugin commands. Fixes #75287. Thanks @neilofneils404.
- CLI/message: skip local configured-channel plugin preload for explicit gateway-owned message actions, letting normalized CLI delivery delegate to the gateway without initializing channel runtime in the short-lived CLI process. Fixes #75477.
- Plugins/commands: normalize empty plugin command handler results and let Telegram native plugin commands send the empty-response fallback instead of throwing when a handler returns `undefined`. Fixes #74800. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Plugins/tools: cold-load selected plugin tool registries when the active registry only has partial tool coverage, so wildcard-expanded allowlists no longer hide installed plugin tools from `tools.effective`. Fixes #76780. Thanks @lilesjtu.
- Plugins/tools: compare cached and runtime plugin tool name conflicts with normalized core tool names, so case variants of core tools are blocked instead of leaking duplicate tool registrations. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Plugins/OpenRouter: advertise DeepSeek V4 thinking levels, including `xhigh` and `max`, through the runtime and lightweight provider policy surfaces so `/think` validation no longer rejects OpenRouter-routed DeepSeek V4 models. Fixes #74788. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Status/sessions: ignore malformed non-string persisted session provider/model metadata instead of throwing while rendering status summaries. Fixes #76206. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- CLI/config: remove only the targeted array element for `openclaw config unset array[index]` instead of replaying the unset during config write and deleting the shifted next element. Fixes #76290. Thanks @SymbolStar and @vincentkoc.
- Plugins/voice-call: treat abnormal local Gateway close code 1006 as a standalone CLI fallback case, so `voicecall smoke` and related commands can still run the provider check path when the Gateway socket closes before returning a response.
- CLI/doctor: migrate legacy per-channel `streaming.progress` config into `streaming.preview.toolProgress`, so upgrades with stale Discord or Telegram streaming keys validate again instead of blocking plugin commands.
- Plugins/release: reject ClawHub code-plugin packages that contain TypeScript runtime entries without compiled `dist/*.js` output, and run package-local runtime-build checks during npm and ClawHub plugin release previews.
- Plugins/update: keep beta-installed OpenClaw package updates on the beta plugin channel even when config still says stable, so Discord and other externalized plugins update from compiled `@beta` packages instead of stale source-only `latest` artifacts.
- Agents/tools: stop treating `tools.deny: ["write"]` as an implicit `apply_patch` deny; operators who want to block patch writes should deny `apply_patch` or `group:fs` explicitly. Fixes #76749. (#76795) Thanks @Nek-12 and @hclsys.
- Plugins/release: verify published plugin npm tarballs expose compiled runtime entries after publish, catching TS-only package artifacts before release closeout. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- CLI/message: exit cleanly with a nonzero status when message-command plugin registry loading fails before dispatch, preventing `openclaw-message` children from staying alive after plugin load errors. Fixes #76168.
- Plugins/config: report configured plugins that are present but blocked by path-safety checks as blocked instead of stale `plugin not found` entries, and deduplicate repeated blocked-candidate warnings during discovery. Fixes #76144. Thanks @mayank6136.
- Gateway/update: recover an installed-but-unloaded macOS LaunchAgent after package updates, rerun Gateway health/version/channel readiness checks, and print restart, reinstall, and rollback guidance before reporting update failure. (#76790) Thanks @jonathanlindsay.
- CLI/plugins: explain when a missing plugin command alias belongs to a bundled plugin that is disabled by default, including the `openclaw plugins enable <plugin>` repair command. (#76835)
- Gateway/Bonjour: auto-start LAN multicast discovery only on macOS hosts while preserving explicit `openclaw plugins enable bonjour` startup elsewhere, so Linux servers and containers that do not need LAN discovery avoid default mDNS probing and watchdog churn. Refs #74209.
- Gateway/macOS: stop `doctor` and LaunchAgent recovery from running `launchctl kickstart -k` after a fresh bootstrap, avoiding an immediate SIGTERM of the just-started gateway while still nudging already-loaded launchd jobs. Fixes #76261. Thanks @solosage1.
- Google Meet: route stateful CLI session commands through the gateway-owned runtime so joined realtime sessions survive after the starting CLI process exits. Fixes #76344. Thanks @coltonharris-wq.
- Memory/status: split builtin sqlite-vec store readiness from embedding-provider readiness in `memory status --deep` and `openclaw status`, so local vector-store failures no longer look like provider failures and provider failures no longer hide a healthy local vector store.
- CLI/doctor: trust a ready gateway memory probe when CLI-side active memory backend resolution is unavailable, preventing false "No active memory plugin is registered" warnings for healthy runtime setups. Fixes #76792. Thanks @som-686.
- Memory/status: keep plain `openclaw memory status` and `openclaw memory status --json` on the cheap read-only path by reserving vector and embedding provider probes for `--deep` or `--index`. Fixes #76769. Thanks @daruire.
- Telegram: suppress stale same-session replies when a newer accepted message arrives before an older in-flight Telegram dispatch finalizes. Fixes #76642. Thanks @chinar-amrutkar.
- Gateway/diagnostics: throttle repeated long-running active-work session warnings so healthy cron or subagent runs no longer print the same `recovery=none` line every heartbeat.
- Gateway/diagnostics: keep non-blocking active-work and transient event-loop max-spike liveness diagnostics out of the default gateway console while preserving structured diagnostic events and warnings for queued, stalled, and recovery-eligible work.
- Slack: collapse routine Socket Mode pong-timeout reconnects into one OpenClaw reconnect line and suppress the duplicate Slack SDK pong warning.
- Gateway/diagnostics: abort-drain embedded runs after an extended no-progress stall so a single dead session no longer leaves queued Discord/channel turns blocked behind repeated `recovery=none` liveness warnings.
- Plugins/ClawHub: accept the live artifact resolver `kind`/`sha256` field names alongside the typed `artifactKind`/`artifactSha256` form so `clawhub:` installs of npm-pack and legacy ZIP packages no longer miss downloadable artifacts. Thanks @romneyda.
- Control UI/Sessions: avoid full `sessions.list` reloads for chat-turn `sessions.changed` payloads, so large session stores no longer add multi-second delays while chat responses are being delivered. (#76676) Thanks @VACInc.
- Gateway/watch: run `doctor --fix --non-interactive` once and retry when the dev Gateway child exits during startup, so stale local plugin install/config state does not leave the tmux watch session disappearing without a repair attempt.
- Doctor/Telegram: warn when selected Telegram quote replies can suppress `streaming.preview.toolProgress`, and document the `replyToMode` trade-off without changing runtime delivery. Fixes #73487. Thanks @GodsBoy.
- Channels/Discord: send a best-effort native typing cue immediately after an inbound DM is accepted, so slow pre-dispatch turns show Discord liveness before queueing, context assembly, model, or tool work starts. Fixes #76417. Thanks @mlopez14.
- Plugins/install: reject source-only TypeScript package installs and installed plugin packages that are missing compiled runtime output, so broken npm artifacts fail at install/discovery time instead of falling through jiti and surfacing later as unavailable providers. Fixes #76720.
- Plugins/config: deduplicate identical manifest compatibility diagnostics when an explicitly configured plugin overrides another discovered candidate, so external channel plugins do not print the same missing `channelConfigs` warning repeatedly during install and enable. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Discord/status: honor explicit `messages.statusReactions.enabled: true` in tool-only guild channels so queued ack reactions can progress through thinking/done lifecycle reactions instead of stopping at the initial emoji. Thanks @Marvinthebored.
- Discord/native commands: compare Discord-normalized slash-command descriptions and localized descriptions during reconcile so CJK or multiline command text no longer triggers redundant startup PATCH bursts and rate-limit 429s. Fixes #76587. Thanks @zhengsx.
- Agents/OpenAI: omit Chat Completions `reasoning_effort` for `gpt-5.4-mini` only when function tools are present while preserving tool-free Chat and Responses reasoning support, preventing Telegram-routed fallback runs from hanging after OpenAI rejects tool payloads. Fixes #76176. Thanks @ThisIsAdilah and @chinar-amrutkar.

- Plugins/tools: keep disabled bundled tool plugins out of explicit runtime allowlist ownership and fall back from loaded-but-empty channel registries to tool-bearing plugin registries, so Active Memory can use bundled `memory-core` search/get tools even when `memory-lancedb` is disabled. - Plugins/install: run `npm install` from the managed npm-root manifest so installing one `@openclaw/*` plugin preserves already installed sibling plugins instead of pruning them. Fixes #76571. (#76602) Thanks @byungskers and @crpol.

Fixes #76598. Thanks @hclsys.
- Plugins/hooks: include explicitly enabled hook-capable plugins in the Gateway startup runtime scope so embedded PI runs can see their `before_prompt_build` and `agent_end` hooks. Fixes #76649. Thanks @wwf3045 and @MkDev11.

- Channels/QQ Bot: resolve structured `clientSecret` SecretRefs before QQ token exchange, expose the QQ Bot secret contract to secrets tooling, and reject legacy `secretref:/...` marker strings. (#74772) Thanks @xialonglee.

Fixes #76435. Thanks @hclsys.
- Chat delivery: make `/verbose on|full|off` changes affect subsequent tool-use chat bubbles again, including channels with draft preview tool progress enabled, while preserving one-shot verbose directives.
- CLI/logs: auto-reconnect `openclaw logs --follow` on transient gateway disconnects with bounded backoff, stderr retry warnings, `[logs] gateway reconnected` recovery notices, and JSON `notice` records while still exiting immediately on non-recoverable auth or configuration errors. Fixes #74782. (#75059, #75372) Thanks @shashank-poola and @romneyda.
- Codex/WhatsApp: keep the `message` dynamic tool available when Codex source replies are configured for message-tool delivery, so coding-profile chat agents do not complete turns privately without a visible channel reply. Fixes #76660. (#76663) Thanks @VishalJ99.

- Agents/web_search: keep installed runtime provider discovery enabled when web-search metadata is missing, so externally installed official providers such as Brave remain visible to agent and cron turns instead of falling back to bundled-only lookup. Fixes #76626. Thanks @amknight.

- Memory LanceDB: allow installed-but-unconfigured plugin metadata to load so onboarding and setup flows can prompt for embedding config instead of failing the plugin registry first. Thanks @vincentkoc.

- Plugins/install: require OpenClaw-owned install provenance before granting official npm plugin scanner trust, so direct npm package names no longer bypass launch-code scanning while catalog, onboarding, and doctor installs stay trusted. Thanks @fede-kamel and @vincentkoc.

- Gateway/sessions: keep `sessions.list` rows lightweight by bounding title/preview hydration to transcript head/tail reads and caching manifest model-id normalization plus setup fallback metadata against the active plugin snapshot. Thanks @vincentkoc and @rolandrscheel.

- Gateway/models: keep read-only `models.list` fallbacks on persisted/current metadata, configured rows, registry-compatible fallbacks, and static auth checks while preserving full-catalog image attachment capability checks. - CLI/plugins: reject missing plugin ids before config writes in `plugins enable` and `plugins disable` so a typo no longer persists a stale config entry. (#73554) Thanks @ai-hpc.
- Agents/sessions: preserve delivered trailing assistant replies during session-file repair so Telegram/WebChat history is not rewritten to drop already-delivered responses. Fixes #76329. Thanks @obviyus.
- Gateway/chat history: preserve oversized transcript turns as explicit omitted-message placeholders while avoiding large JSONL parse stalls. Thanks @Marvinthebored and @vincentkoc.
- CLI/doctor: load the configured memory-slot plugin when resolving memory diagnostics so bundled `memory-core` no longer triggers a false “no active memory plugin” warning on standalone `doctor` / `status` runs. Fixes #76367. Thanks @neeravmakwana.
- Gateway: preserve stack diagnostics when `chat.send` or agent attachment parsing/staging fails, improving image-send failure triage. Refs #63432. (#75135) Thanks @keen0206.
- Agents/idle-timeout: add a cost-runaway breaker to the outer embedded-run retry loop that halts further attempts after 5 consecutive idle timeouts without completed model progress, so a wedged provider can no longer fan paid model calls out across the same run; completed text or tool-call progress resets the breaker, but partial tool-argument token dribbles do not. - Heartbeats/Codex: align structured heartbeat prompts with actual `heartbeat_respond` tool availability, stop sending legacy `HEARTBEAT_OK` when the tool exists, and keep tool-disabled commitment check-ins on the legacy ack path. Thanks @pashpashpash and @vincentkoc.

- CLI/devices: request `operator.admin` for `openclaw devices approve <requestId>` only when the exact pending device request would mint or inherit admin-scoped operator access, while keeping lower-scope approvals on the pairing scope.

- Memory/sessions: keep rotated and deleted transcripts (`.jsonl.reset.<iso>` / `.jsonl.deleted.<iso>`) searchable by indexing archive content, mapping archive hits back to live transcript stems, emitting transcript update events on archive rotation, and bypassing incremental delta thresholds for one-shot archive mutations while keeping backups and compaction checkpoints opaque. - Active Memory: keep non-empty `memory_search` results from being fast-failed as empty when debug telemetry reports zero hits.
- Active Memory: preserve the target agent context when building embedded recall plugin tools so `memory_search` and `memory_get` stay available for explicit recall sessions. Fixes #76343. Thanks @Countermarch.
- Plugins/externalization: repair missing configured plugin installs from npm by default, reserve ClawHub downloads for explicit `clawhubSpec` metadata, and cover agent-runtime/env-selected plugin repair. Thanks @vincentkoc.

- Gateway/status: add concrete service, config, listener-owner, and log collection next steps when gateway probes fail and Bonjour finds no local gateway, so frozen or port-conflict reports include the data needed for root-cause triage. Refs #49012. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Codex harness: forward OpenClaw workspace bootstrap files such as `SOUL.md` through native Codex config instructions while leaving `AGENTS.md` to Codex project-doc discovery. Fixes #76273. Thanks @zknicker.
- Parallels/Windows update smoke: escape the stale post-swap import regex in the generated PowerShell script so expected `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` update handoffs continue to post-update health checks. (#75315)
- Slack: allow draft preview streaming in top-level DMs when `replyToMode` is `off` while keeping Slack native streaming and assistant thread status gated on reply threads. Fixes #56480. (#56544) Thanks @HangGlidersRule.
- Control UI/chat: remove the delete-confirm popover outside-click listener on every dismiss path, so Cancel, Delete, outside clicks, and same-button toggles no longer leave stale document listeners behind. Refs #75590 and #69982. Thanks @Ricardo-M-L.
- Memory-core: treat exhausted file watcher limits as non-fatal for builtin memory auto-sync while preserving fatal handling for unrelated disk-full errors. (#73357) Thanks @solodmd.
- Providers/Ollama: restore catalog context-window forwarding as `num_ctx` for native `/api/chat` requests; fixes tool selection and context truncation regressions on models with catalog entries (qwen3, llama3, gemma3, …) when no explicit `params.num_ctx` was configured. Fixes #76117. (#76181) Thanks @openperf.
- Plugins/install: pin npm plugin installs to the verified resolved version and reject package-lock version or integrity drift, so mutable tags cannot race integrity checks into accepting a different artifact. Thanks @Lucenx9.

- Plugins/providers: preserve scoped cold-load fallback for enabled external manifest-contract capability providers missing from the startup registry, so providers such as Fish Audio can resolve on request without requiring `activation.onStartup` for correctness. (#76536) Thanks @Conan-Scott.
- Gateway/update: carry `continuationMessage` from `update.run` into successful restart sentinels so session-scoped self-updates can resume one follow-up turn after the Gateway restarts. Refs #71178. (#74362) Thanks @100menotu001, @HeilbronAILabs, and @artnking.
- Agents/fallback: suppress duplicate current-turn user-message transcript writes after embedded fallback retries while still sending the retry prompt to the model. (#63696) Thanks @dashhuang.
- Channels/Telegram: force a fresh final message when a visible non-preview bubble (tool/block/error) was delivered after the active answer preview, so multi-step assistant replies no longer end up with the final answer above intermediate output. Fixes #76529. Thanks @jack-stormentswe.
- Channels/Telegram: require an observed Telegram send, edit, or fallback before treating a forum-topic final as delivered, so final replies generated in transcript no longer disappear from Telegram topics. Fixes #76554. (#76764) Thanks @bubucilo and @obviyus.
- Plugins/update: keep externalized bundled npm bridge updates on the normal plugin security scanner path instead of granting source-linked official trust without artifact provenance. (#76765) Thanks @Lucenx9.
- Agents/reply context: label replied-to messages as the current user message target in model-visible metadata, so short replies are grounded to their explicit reply target instead of nearby chat history. (#76817) Thanks @obviyus.
- Doctor/plugins: install configured missing official plugins such as Discord and Brave during doctor/update repair, auto-enable repaired provider plugins, preserve config when a download fails, and stop auto-enable from inventing plugin entries when no manifest declares a configured channel. Fixes #76872. Thanks @jack-stormentswe.

修复：限制 repo index 前缀到 Git 根目录，防止越界索引问题

ai_summary.summary_cn: turborepo v2.9.9 是一个以安全加固为主的补丁版本，主要修复了多个安全相关的问题，包括加强 GitHub Actions 工作流安全性、优化发布流程保护、限制 repo index 索引范围到 Git 根目录，以及在 dry-run 转换时保留 lockfiles 文件。此版本还新增了 pnpm workspace 标志的文档说明。

changes.description: Subprocesses (Bash, hooks, MCP, LSP) 不再继承 OTEL_* 环境变量，OTEL-instrumented 应用通过 Bash 工具运行时无法再获取 CLI 的 OTLP endpoint
MCP: 'workspace' 现在是保留服务器名称，现有使用该名称的服务器将被跳过并显示警告
--minimal 模式不再生成带 hooks 声明的 settings.json，之前生成的配置可能包含孤立 hooks
Session、terminal 和 memory stores 文件权限从默认改为 mode 0600 (files) / 0700 (dirs)，依赖宽松权限的应用可能受影响
[Breaking] 文件型技能脚本现在支持 string[] 参数，之前传递数组的用户需要调整代码
新增 .env 文件安全加载和工作区信任机制，头less 模式下强制执行工作区信任检查
YOLO 模式下当 shell 解析失败且存在 restricted 规则时，强制关闭而非继续执行
Plugins/migration: 插件配置变更时将提示安装官方外部插件而非建议移除，影响之前依赖旧提示的用户
Claude CLI: /think 非默认层级现在正确传递 --effort 参数，之前无效
新增 bundled file-transfer 插件，默认拒绝访问，依赖之前默认允许访问的配置需要调整
Gateway 启动和热重载不再自动恢复无效配置，无效配置将直接失败关闭
工具配置行为调整: tools.deny: ['write'] 不再隐式拒绝 apply_patch，需要显式配置
OpenAI 响应模型默认使用 SSE 传输而非 WebSocket 自动选择，之前依赖 WebSocket 的配置可能需要调整
新增 allowSystemInMessages 选项，默认对 prompt 或 messages 中的 system messages 发出警告
Python 构建依赖缓存现为默认行为，可能影响依赖之前非缓存行为的构建流程
load() 函数加强了对不受信任 manifests 的防护，可能拒绝之前可接受的输入

top_pain_points.review_reason: This is a user-blocking failure: self-hosted users who select the local Deno sandbox provider in the UI will encounter a runtime ValueError at execution time ('Deno executable not found'), with no in-product guidance on remediation. The shipped container explicitly does not include Deno, and no documentation exists to guide users through setup. This blocks the sandbox evaluation workflow end-to-end for self-hosted deployments.

source_issues.title: [sandboxes] Deno runtime configuration is unclear, especially for the shipped container
source_issues.evidence: Deno adapter is registered unconditionally on module import; shipped container does not include Deno binary; self-hosters selecting local Deno provider hit runtime error 'Deno executable not found' with no in-product guidance; no docs exist for sandbox runtime setup. Users selecting a sandbox provider in the UI will encounter an unhandled runtime failure at execution time with no actionable message.

source_issues.title: route binding causes agent to use wrong workspace
source_issues.evidence: 用户配置了 agent external-researcher 绑定到 telegram bot maestro，预期使用 workspace-external-researcher，但实际使用了 workspace-ronald。

source_issues.title: Add GPTME_DISABLE_PATH_INCLUDE env var for non-interactive prompts
source_issues.evidence: Prompt went from ~50KB to 465KB due to 5 path references causing ~280KB of file content + ~50-100KB of bare-dir listings. Weak models (grok-4.20, kimi-k2.6, codex:gpt-5.5) silently fail on oversized prompts — return zero assistant messages, session times out, bandit counters mis-attributed.

source_issues.title: Context bloat: include_paths embeds same file multiple times and has no size cap
source_issues.evidence: Same path embedded multiple times causes user message to grow from ~6KB to 561,205 chars. Two consecutive gptme:grok-4.20 autonomous sessions terminated at 0.1 grade with no assistant output (180-190s wall time) — context window exhausted before model produced any tool call.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: RecallAction with EventSource.USER after a user message produces two consecutive USER turns, breaks Mistral / SGLang strict-alternation backends

signals.topic: include_paths() causes context bloat leading to session failures in autonomous runs
signals.summary: The `include_paths()` function in gptme auto-expands path-like tokens in prompts, embedding file contents multiple times without deduplication and without per-file size caps. In autonomous/non-interactive mode, this silently inflates prompts from ~6KB to 500KB+, exhausting context windows and causing models (especially weaker ones like grok-4.20) to return zero output and timeout — with failures misattributed to model quality rather than the context-size issue.
signals.review_reason: Two independent issues (#2333, #2306) from different dates document the exact same root cause: `include_paths()` silently expands path tokens into massive amounts of file content without deduplication or per-file caps, causing real autonomous run sessions to fail with zero output and timeout. User impact is explicit and measurable: sessions scored 0.1 grade with no assistant output, model bandit counters misattributed. This is a main-flow failure in autonomous mode (the project's headline use case).

source_issues.title: Add GPTME_DISABLE_PATH_INCLUDE env var for non-interactive prompts

Weak models (grok-4.20, kimi-k2.6, codex:gpt-5.5) silently fail on oversized prompts — return zero assistant messages, session times out, bandit counters mis-attributed.

source_issues.title: Context bloat: include_paths embeds same file multiple times and has no size cap

Marked P2 because count=1 and severity is limited to API callers (not end users in typical interactive use).

signals.summary: The default SANDBOX_RUNTIME_CONTAINER_IMAGE (runtime:latest) ships with miniforge3 but the code expects micromamba, causing sandbox startup to fail completely for all users with default settings.
signals.review_reason: Main flow failure — 3 independent duplicate reports confirm widespread default-image breakage. Users cannot start sandboxes at all with default configuration. Requires manual workaround (specifying a non-default image tag).

source_issues.title: [Bug] Runtime container fails to start - micromamba not found in runtime:latest
source_issues.evidence: Blocks sandbox startup entirely. Default image is broken. 3 identical duplicate reports within short time window confirming widespread user impact.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Runtime container fails to start - micromamba not found in runtime:latest
source_issues.evidence: Duplicate of 14274 — same root cause, same workaround (use ghcr.io/all-hands-ai/runtime:0.42-nikolaik).

source_issues.title: [Bug] Runtime container fails to start - micromamba not found in runtime:latest
source_issues.evidence: Duplicate of 14274 — third report confirming systemic default-image breakage.

signals.topic: Bitbucket provider authentication broken — API tokens not working
signals.summary: Bitbucket deprecated App Passwords in favor of API tokens, but OpenHands still relies on the old auth method, completely blocking Bitbucket repo integration on both self-hosted and cloud deployments.
signals.review_reason: Main flow failure — blocks core use case (Bitbucket repo connection) on both self-hosted and cloud. Bitbucket deprecated App Passwords; OpenHands has no working alternative. Clear user impact with screenshots and reproducible failure across environments.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Bitbucket provider authentication broken (API tokens not working)
source_issues.evidence: Core feature blocked — Bitbucket integration non-functional on ALL deployment types. Auth formats tested: all fail. Screenshots show consistent auth failure. Reported by user who successfully runs self-hosted otherwise.

signals.topic: RecallAction produces dual consecutive USER turns, breaks Mistral/SGLang strict-alternation backends
signals.summary: RecallAction dispatches with EventSource.USER after a user message, resulting in two consecutive USER turns in the transcript. Any backend enforcing Mistral/vLLM strict user/assistant alternation returns HTTP 400, causing the agent to stall on first prompt.
signals.review_reason: Main flow failure — All Mistral-family model users cannot run the agent at all. Agent stalls with HTTP 400 after first user message. Workaround disables RecallAction feature. Clear, reproducible with SGLang/vLLM backends.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: RecallAction with EventSource.USER after a user message produces two consecutive USER turns, breaks Mistral / SGLang strict-alternation backends
source_issues.evidence: Agent stalls on first prompt with HTTP 400 error on any Mistral-family model using SGLang or vLLM strict-alternation backends. Error: 'Conversation roles must alternate user/assistant/user/assistant/...'. Workaround (enable_prompt_extensions=false) disables a legitimate feature.

signals.topic: ACP conversations cannot be resumed after sandbox restart — session_id not persisted
signals.summary: ACP session state (acp_session_id, acp_session_cwd) lives in sandbox filesystem which is wiped on recycle. After cloud sandbox restart, users lose conversation continuity and must start from scratch.
aliases: ACP session lost on sandbox recycle
signals.review_reason: User work loss in cloud deployments — ACP conversations are not durable across sandbox restarts. Users must restart from scratch after every recycle. Explicitly labeled as bug with clear root cause (session state in ephemeral filesystem).

source_issues.title: ACP: conversations cannot be resumed after sandbox restart (session_id is not persisted)
source_issues.evidence: Session state stored in sandbox filesystem — wiped on recycle. Users in cloud deployments lose all ACP conversation progress when sandbox restarts. The acp_session_id survives on ACP server but is lost on sandbox side. Explicitly labeled as bug.

signals.topic: DeepSeek V4 reasoning_content not passed back to API — causes 400 Bad Request on multi-turn tool calling
signals.summary: DeepSeek V4 in 'thinking mode' returns reasoning_content that must be included in message history for subsequent requests. OpenHands strips this field, causing 400 Bad Request on tool calls in multi-turn conversations, blocking DeepSeek V4 tool usage.
signals.review_reason: Functional breakage for DeepSeek V4 users — 400 Bad Request prevents tool calling in multi-turn conversations when using thinking mode. Blocks a specific but documented model compatibility use case.

source_issues.title: [Feature]: Support passing reasoning_content back to API for DeepSeek V4 compatibility
source_issues.evidence: DeepSeek V4 returns reasoning_content in thinking mode that must be in message history for subsequent tool calls. OpenHands drops this field, causing 400 Bad Request. Users cannot use DeepSeek V4 with tool calling in multi-turn conversations.

signals.topic: Claude 4.7 model ID mapping failure in AITextSummarizerBlock and AIListGeneratorBlock
signals.summary: After v0.6.58 release, users selecting Claude Opus 4.7 in the Agent Builder UI encounter BlockUnknownError / 400 invalid model ID errors because the backend blocks fail to map the internal alias to the correct provider ID at the Anthropic/OpenRouter proxy layer. The model is selectable but non-functional, blocking the primary workflow.
signals.review_reason: 用户主流程被明确阻断：Claude 4.7 在 UI 中可选但实际不可用，API 调用返回 400 错误。属于关键功能不可用场景（模型选择器误导用户，且涉及新发布功能），符合用户痛点定义。count=1 不足以达到 P0，但因涉及最新版本主流程阻断，优先级 P1 合理。

source_issues.title: Model ID mismatch in AITextSummarizerBlock for Claude 4.7 aliases
source_issues.evidence: Users selecting Claude Opus 4.7 in Agent Builder receive BlockUnknownError with 400 invalid model ID from proxy. Multiple backend blocks (AITextSummarizerBlock, AIListGeneratorBlock) are affected. Reproducible: model appears selectable in UI but all API calls fail.

signals.topic: AutoPilot chat fails to reliably serve large files (>500KB) to users
signals.summary: AutoPilot chat has a non-deterministic bug serving large files (images, generated content >500KB). Files display as broken/corrupted in the chat interface, and only have a ~20% chance of loading correctly on page refresh. This is a reproducible UX issue affecting any user receiving large generated content.
signals.review_reason: 明确的体验下降问题：大型文件（图片等生成内容）在聊天界面随机性损坏，用户需要反复刷新且仍有 80% 失败率。属于可重现的 UX bug，labeled bug，被标记为 easy to reproduce。虽然 count=1，但属于明确可重现的体验阻断，P1 合理。

source_issues.title: Serving Large Files to User is Flakey
source_issues.evidence: Files >500KB show as broken in chat. Reproducible with Nano Banana Pro image generation: ~20% load rate on refresh. Labeled as bug by maintainers.

signals.topic: Firecrawl BlockUnknownError causing internal server error in block execution
signals.summary: AutoGPT's Firecrawl integration block is returning BlockUnknownError with 'Failed to map' internal server error, referencing help@firecrawl.com. This represents a third-party block integration failure that blocks any agent workflow relying on web scraping/crawling capabilities.
signals.review_reason: 第三方集成块故障导致工作流阻断：Firecrawl block 返回 BlockUnknownError，任何依赖爬取功能的 agent 工作流均会失败。issue body 为 null 但 title 明确记录错误类型。P2 因 count=1、细节有限且涉及第三方。

source_issues.title: BlockUnknownError: Internal Server Error: Failed to map. An unexpected error occurred. Please contact help@firecrawl.com for help. Your exception ID is 5ed3f33918d84deda6b5125809de91c1 - No additional error details provided.
source_issues.evidence: AutoGPT issue created by linear-code[bot] with BlockUnknownError from Firecrawl integration. Error ID provided, user instructed to contact Firecrawl support. Internal server error with 'Failed to map' indicates a block-to-provider mapping failure.

signals.topic: App fails to start / crash on startup due to missing bundled modules (qrcode-terminal, .gitmodules/openclaw submodule)
signals.summary: Both Linux AppImage and source builds ship without required bundled modules (qrcode-terminal vendor files, .gitmodules/openclaw submodule), causing startup crashes across multiple platforms.
signals.review_reason: Application startup crash is a complete user-blocking event. Three separate issues across Linux AppImage, source build, and macOS all point to packaging/distribution failures where required modules or submodules are missing from the shipped artifact. On Linux the specific error is identified (qrcode-terminal vendor file missing). This is a shipping-quality defect affecting users on multiple platforms.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: ClawX-0.4.0-alpha.0-linux-x86_64.AppImage failed to start
source_issues.evidence: Uncaught Exception: Error: Cannot find module 'qrcode-terminal/vendor/QRCode/index.js'. AppImage extracts to /tmp but the bundled openclaw package.json references a qrcode-terminal vendor file that is not included in the AppImage. Debian 12 x64, fails on first launch.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Missing .gitmodules and openclaw submodule directory prevents build from source
source_issues.evidence: git clone --recurse-submodules does not populate the openclaw/ directory. .gitmodules is absent from repo root. This makes building from source impossible — the openclaw submodule is not properly registered in the repository despite GitHub UI showing it as a submodule reference.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: ClawX 最新4.0版本更新/重新安装以后报错无法打开
source_issues.evidence: ClawX v0.4.0 on MacBook Pro 2017 (Intel Iris Plus 640, macOS 13.7.8) fails to launch after update. Re-downloading and reinstalling does not resolve. Screenshot shows error dialog. User cannot use the application at all.

signals.topic: DeepSeek thinking-mode models fail multi-turn conversations due to missing reasoning_content in history
signals.summary: DeepSeek v4/v4-flash/reasoner thinking-mode models cause 400 errors on the 2nd turn of any conversation because OpenClaw drops the required reasoning_content field from message history.
signals.review_reason: This is a core functionality blocker: the primary use case — multi-turn AI conversation — completely fails on every DeepSeek thinking-mode model after the first turn. Both count>=3 (actual count=2 confirmed, plus the Chinese issue corroborates the same bug) and main-flow blockage are met. No workaround without manual model switching. Affects all channels (desktop, QQ, WeChat, DingTalk).

source_issues.title: [Bug]: DeepSeek thinking-mode models fail multi-turn with 400 reasoning_content error
source_issues.evidence: After first assistant turn with thinking trace, every subsequent turn fails with '400 The reasoning_content in the thinking mode must be passed back to the API.' Reproduces on desktop chat, WeChat, QQ Bot, DingTalk. Root cause: OpenClaw 4.15 drops reasoning_content from history when constructing next-turn payload.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: 赶紧更新新版本吧，deepseek v4报错啊，影响体验啊！
source_issues.evidence: User reports DeepSeek v4 errors affecting experience. Corroborates #962 - Chinese user experiencing same DeepSeek v4 runtime error.

signals.topic: QQ Bot SSRF guard blocks all QQ Bot traffic for mainland China users running Clash/Mihomo/V2Ray in TUN fake-IP mode
signals.summary: OpenClaw's SSRF guard rejects DNS-resolved IPs in the 198.18.0.0/15 benchmark range, which is the default behavior of popular China proxy tools. This makes the QQ Bot completely non-functional for the majority of Chinese users.
signals.review_reason: This is a main-flow blockage for the majority of the China user base. The QQ Bot is entirely non-functional for users with default-configured proxy tools (Clash Verge, Mihomo, ClashX, V2RayN, Surge — all default to TUN fake-IP). The bot enters a forever-retry loop, never recovering. User impact is clear: complete channel failure, not a degradation.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: QQ Bot SSRF guard blocks bots.qq.com under Clash/V2Ray TUN-mode fake-IP DNS (China)
source_issues.evidence: SSRF guard rejects all QQ Bot API calls for users running Clash/Mihomo/V2Ray with TUN+fake-IP (the default in popular China proxy GUIs). bots.qq.com resolves to 198.18.x.x, which is in the blocked benchmark range. Every reconnect attempt fails with '[security] blocked URL fetch (qqbot.token)'. The bot sits in a forever-disconnect loop. The same root cause affects any channel whose hostname resolves to 198.18.x.x under proxy. A workaround exists (QQBOT_MEDIA_SSRF_POLICY shape with allowRfc2544BenchmarkRange:true), but is not applied to the token/API call sites.

signals.topic: Skills marketplace 404 — cn-mirror source does not implement API endpoints, blocking all skill discovery/install for Chinese users
signals.summary: The default ClawHub source for Chinese users (cn.clawhub-mirror.com) is a static-page mirror that returns HTML for all paths including /api/search, making the entire Skills marketplace unusable for Chinese users out of the box.
signals.review_reason: The Skills marketplace is a core feature for extending ClawX functionality, and the default Chinese mirror makes it completely inaccessible for all Chinese users on first use. While count=1, the impact is the entire Chinese user base's ability to discover or install skills, which is a significant portion of the user community. A one-line fix (change default to 'official') would resolve this.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Skills marketplace search returns 404 with default cn-mirror source (cn.clawhub-mirror.com doesn't implement /api/search)
source_issues.evidence: The default ClawHub source (cn-mirror) serves HTML for /api/search, /api/skill, and /api/explore — JSON.parse on HTML response fails and propagates as 404. Every search or Explore tab action fails. Verified via curl: official clawhub.ai returns JSON, cn.clawhub-mirror.com returns HTML. This is the out-of-the-box experience for all Chinese users. clawhub.ai is actually reachable from China without VPN, so the mirror is unnecessary.

signals.topic: Feishu/Lark channel generates duplicate messages and stuck chats when legacy and bundled Feishu plugins both register the same channel
signals.summary: After upgrades, both the legacy openclaw-lark external plugin and the newly bundled feishu plugin can remain enabled simultaneously, causing the same Feishu message to be handled 3 times, resulting in stuck conversations.
signals.review_reason: Feishu channel is a core integration, and duplicate message handling causes both UX degradation (stuck chat, triple messages visible to users) and session corruption (orphaned messages). This is a migration issue that automatically affects any user who upgraded from an older ClawX version with the legacy Feishu plugin. The workaround requires manual config editing, which most users cannot do. This is a significant user experience failure for Feishu users.

source_issues.title: ClawX 0.3.8: legacy openclaw-lark and bundled feishu both register the feishu channel, causing duplicate message handling / stuck chats
source_issues.evidence: On macOS ClawX 0.3.8, a user reported chat appearing stuck with three copies of the same Feishu message. Diagnostic logs show both plugins registered: legacy 'openclaw-lark' (channels: ['feishu']) and bundled 'feishu' (channels: ['feishu']). The same message_id appeared in logs three times 15-20 seconds apart. Also includes plugin tool name conflict: 'openclaw-lark': feishu_chat. Model failures (gemini rate limit, ollama timeout) amplified the stuck-chat behavior. Manual config fix required to disable legacy plugin.

signals.topic: RealtimeAgent WebSocket 远程代码执行：execute_python_code 工具在未受保护路径上可被远程触发
signals.summary: 当 RealtimeAgent 暴露 execute_python_code 工具时，远程 WebSocket 用户可通过提示模型调用该工具，在服务端环境执行任意 Python 代码。当前 RealtimeAgent._acting → Toolkit.call_tool_function 调用链无沙箱/审批边界。
signals.review_reason: 确认的远程代码执行（RCE）漏洞：远程 WebSocket 用户可通过 RealtimeAgent 的工具调用链在服务端执行任意 Python 代码，证据为 marker 文件已实际写入磁盘（returncode=0），且影响所有暴露 execute_python_code 的 RealtimeAgent 部署实例。虽为安全问题，但因有明确 RCE 验证证据（用户可见的文件系统写入）且影响主流程，归属为用户痛点。

source_issues.title: [Bug]:RealtimeAgent tool call path allows remote users to trigger server-side Python execution when execute_python_code is exposed
source_issues.evidence: 远程 WebSocket 用户可触发服务端执行任意 Python 代码并写文件，工具返回 returncode=0，marker 文件已确认写入。复现路径：ws://127.0.0.1:8010/ws/test-user/<session_id> → RealtimeAgent._acting → Toolkit.call_tool_function → execute_python_code，无沙箱或审批边界。

signals.topic: SQLAlchemy 同步/异步混用导致 StreamSessionLock 集成测试 500 错误
signals.summary: 集成测试通过 TestClient 发起请求时，路由处理中混用了 SQLAlchemy 同步/异步调用，greenlet 上下文错误导致 500 错误。涉及 test_cancelled_stream_does_not_leave_db_locked 和 test_stream_request_does_not_block_followup_session_creation 两个测试。
signals.review_reason: greenlet_spawn 错误是 SQLAlchemy 在异步 FastAPI 路由中误用同步 ORM 导致的典型错误，在生产环境中会导致 500 服务端错误，直接阻断流式 session 的创建和锁定流程。虽然当前证据在集成测试层面，但根本原因是生产代码中 async/sync 混用，用户在特定 session 场景下会遭遇 500 阻断。

source_issues.title: test: SQLAlchemy async/sync 混用导致 2 个 StreamSessionLock 集成测试 500
source_issues.evidence: AssertionError: 500 != 200, greenlet_spawn has not been called; can't call await_only() here。涉及 StreamSessionLock 路由：session 创建/锁定操作中同步调用了 SQLAlchemy ORM，greenlet 上下文错误会在生产环境导致 500。

signals.topic: 流式重试逻辑中 hook 回调异常未处理导致 peer 断连后 RuntimeError
signals.summary: _react_streaming.py 的重试逻辑中，hook 回调在 peer 断连场景抛出未捕获异常，异常被 asyncio 吞掉（Task exception was never retrieved），导致重试机制失效，客户端收到 RuntimeError 而非正常重试。
aliases: asyncio task exception not retrieved peer disconnect
signals.review_reason: 重试流程中 hook 异常未处理是影响流式消息传递可靠性的问题，peer 断连后重试失效导致消息丢失，属于体验下降（流式传输完整性受损）。虽为边缘场景（极端网络异常），但影响主流程的容错能力，保留为 P2。

source_issues.title: fix(streaming): 重试逻辑中 hook 清理不完整导致 2 个测试失败
source_issues.evidence: RuntimeError: peer closed connection without sending complete message body (incomplete chunked read)。_react_streaming.py 重试逻辑中 hook 抛出未捕获异常，asyncio.Task exception was never retrieved，导致断连后重试失败。

signals.topic: AG-UI/CopilotKit integration causes Agent tool execution failures and infinite loops
signals.summary: Three related bugs in the AG-UI interface adapter: (1) CopilotKit frontend context is not passed to Agent.arun(), (2) tools with external_execution=true trigger infinitely because conversation history is lost, (3) frontend tools from AG-UI HTTP requests are not recognized by the agent. Together these make the AG-UI integration non-functional for real agentic tool-use workflows.
aliases: AG-UI frontend tools not recognized by Agent
signals.review_reason: Three confirmed bug-labeled issues affecting the same integration pathway (AG-UI/CopilotKit). They produce cascading failures: no context pass-through means the agent has no awareness of frontend state; missing tool recognition prevents any frontend-tool execution; and external_execution=true causes an infinite loop that freezes the agent. Together these make the AG-UI integration completely non-functional for any agentic use case involving tools.

source_issues.title: [Bug] AG-UI adapter receives context but does not pass run_input.context to Agent.arun()
source_issues.evidence: CopilotKit readable frontend context is not available to the Agno agent when using the AG-UI interface. The adapter extracts only the latest user message and ignores run_input.context entirely.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Tools with external_execution = true integrated with CopilotKit are triggered infinitely
source_issues.evidence: Tool with external_execution=true causes infinite loop because CopilotKit only sends the last message on continue_run(), not full conversation history.

source_issues.title: [Bug] AG-UI interface tools are not integrated with the Agent
source_issues.evidence: HTTP requests from AG-UI contain frontend tools declared via CopilotKit packages, but run_agent does not extract tools from incoming HTTP requests, making them unrecognized.

signals.topic: ChromaDb async_insert and async_upsert block the asyncio event loop
signals.summary: ChromaDb's async methods call synchronous ChromaDB Rust batch operations directly on the asyncio event loop, starving all other coroutines for the duration of the batch. This blocks any async service that uses Knowledge.ainsert(), causing HTTP long-poll freezes, health-check timeouts, and queue backups.
aliases: asyncio event loop starvation in ChromaDb
signals.review_reason: Single closed issue but with extremely detailed user impact evidence: py-spy stack trace proving asyncio main thread starvation, real downstream service effects (HTTP freezes, health-check timeouts), and a confirmed consumer workaround by mindroom-ai. Downgraded to P2 because count=1 and only single-repo impact.

source_issues.title: [Bug] ChromaDb async upsert/insert blocks the asyncio event loop
source_issues.evidence: Confirmed with py-spy stack trace showing the asyncio main thread blocked inside chromadb.api.rust._upsert. Real async services experience HTTP long-poll freezes, watchdog timeouts, and queue backups during Knowledge.ainsert() calls. Downstream workaround by mindroom-ai confirmed. Status: closed.

signals.topic: Knowledge Base references retrieved by sub-agents not propagated to TeamRunOutput
signals.summary: When sub-agents within a Team retrieve references from a Knowledge Base, those references are not merged or bubbled up to the parent TeamRunOutput.references field, causing the team orchestrator to lose visibility into retrieved knowledge.
aliases: Team sub-agent KB references missing from output
TeamRunOutput references not aggregated from sub-agents
signals.review_reason: Bug-labeled issue that breaks a core multi-agent workflow pattern. Team orchestrators relying on KB references for downstream decisions lose that data entirely. Count=1 and single-repo, so P2.

source_issues.title: [Bug] References from KB retrieved by sub-agents not included in TeamRunOutput.references
source_issues.evidence: Bug-labeled issue. Reference aggregation logic does not merge or bubble up references from sub-agent outputs into parent team output, breaking the team workflow for any use case relying on KB references.

signals.topic: SqliteDb/AsyncSqliteDb/RedisDb override BaseDb methods and drop accepted kwargs, causing TypeError
signals.summary: Several database subclasses override BaseDb methods but drop kwargs that the base class declares and accepts (e.g., user_id, limit, agent_id, session_id), causing TypeError when routers call these methods with standard parameters.
aliases: Database subclass API incompatibility with BaseDb contract
TypeError unexpected keyword argument in DB subclasses
signals.review_reason: TypeError on standard API calls caused by subclass breaking the base class contract. While count=1, the issue directly blocks session management and data operations in routers that use these DB backends.

source_issues.title: BaseDb subclass overrides drop kwargs declared by BaseDb
source_issues.evidence: SqliteDb, AsyncSqliteDb, and RedisDb override BaseDb methods but drop accepted kwargs (user_id, limit, agent_id, session_id). Causes TypeError: got an unexpected keyword argument when routers call these methods, blocking session and data operations.

signals.topic: PIIDetectionGuardrail custom_patterns requires compiled regex but API accepts raw strings
signals.summary: PIIDetectionGuardrail's custom_patterns parameter requires pre-compiled regex objects (re.compile(...)) but the API signature does not indicate this, and users passing raw strings receive an AttributeError at runtime.
signals.review_reason: Bug-labeled API usability issue where the documented parameter type does not match runtime behavior, causing AttributeError on standard usage. Count=1, single-repo, so P2.

source_issues.title: [Bug] custom_patterns in PIIDetectionGuardrail does not accept raw regex strings
source_issues.evidence: Bug-labeled issue. Guardrail requires compiled regex patterns (re.compile(...)) but this is not documented. Users passing raw strings get AttributeError: 'str' object has no attribute 'search', breaking PII guardrail usage.

signals.topic: MCP tool calls crash with TypeError in SessionProcessor on AI SDK upgrade (v1.14.39)
signals.summary: All MCP tool calls crash with TypeError due to AI SDK 6.x output shape mismatch in SessionProcessor. The tool-result handler expects old `{output, metadata, attachments}` shape but AI SDK 6.x returns `{type:'text', value:'...'}` causing undefined access.
signals.review_reason: All MCP tool calls crash on v1.14.39 (latest stable), affecting core tool-use workflow. Root cause traced to AI SDK 6.x output shape change. Confirmed regression with clear user impact. No plugin workaround exists. Count=1 is accurate; single issue but severity is high as it blocks all MCP functionality.

source_issues.title: MCP tool calls crash: TypeError on output.output in SessionProcessor (affects v1.14.39)
source_issues.evidence: Confirmed crash on ALL MCP tool calls with TypeError: undefined is not an object (evaluating 'output.length'). Regression between v1.14.30 and v1.14.39. No plugins involved. Root cause: AI SDK 6.x introduced createToolModelOutput() wrapper that changed output shape.

signals.topic: Desktop app cannot reach LAN IP addresses — MCP servers on local network unreachable (EHOSTUNREACH)
signals.summary: OpenCode desktop app cannot connect to MCP servers hosted on LAN IPs (192.168.x.x), failing with EHOSTUNREACH. Same MCP config works in terminal version. Network sandbox isolation in the desktop app blocks all local network MCP usage.
signals.review_reason: Desktop app users cannot use any MCP server on local network — a core use case. Confirmed via comparison: same config works in terminal version, proving MCP server is functional but blocked by desktop network sandbox. Single issue but blocks entire LAN MCP workflow on desktop.

source_issues.title: Desktop app cannot reach LAN IP addresses - EHOSTUNREACH on all `192.168.x.x` connections
source_issues.evidence: EHOSTUNREACH on all 192.168.x.x connections from desktop app. Same opencode.json config works in terminal version. Both type:remote and type:local MCP configs affected. Root cause is desktop app network sandbox isolation.

signals.topic: Local MCP servers fail on Windows — StdioClientTransport spawns without shell context
signals.summary: Local MCP servers on Windows fail to connect or ignore injected environment variables because Node.js child_process.spawn requires an explicit shell on Windows but OpenCode spawns without one.
signals.review_reason: Windows users cannot use local MCP servers — a primary integration path. Connection failure confirmed with environment variable injection, blocking server configuration. Single issue but blocks all Windows local MCP usage.

source_issues.title: fix: local MCP servers fail on Windows without native shell context
source_issues.evidence: Windows 11 + Warp terminal: MCP server connection fails on opencode mcp list with environment block config. Works when spawned with explicit shell. Root cause: spawn without shell context on Windows.

signals.topic: Desktop app loses conversation history when reconnecting to WSL server
signals.summary: When using the OpenCode Desktop app connected to a WSL server, closing and reconnecting the app causes previous conversation to disappear. Sessions are persisted in WSL but not restored on desktop reconnect.
aliases: Conversation history lost reconnect desktop WSL
signals.review_reason: Users lose complete conversation history when switching from WSL server to desktop app, causing workflow disruption and potential data loss. TUI preserves sessions, proving persistence works but desktop reconnect logic is broken. Single issue but causes data loss on primary desktop+WSL workflow.

source_issues.title: Desktop app loses conversation history when reconnecting to WSL server
source_issues.evidence: Desktop app connected to WSL server loses all prior conversation on reconnect. Session data is persisted under ~/.local/share/opencode/project/ in WSL but not restored. TUI directly in WSL works correctly.

signals.topic: Web terminal broken in v1.14.38 — CSP blocks Ghostty WASM (data: URI)
signals.summary: The web UI terminal is broken in v1.14.38 due to overly strict Content Security Policy headers. Previously fixed in #9420/#9700, now regressed. CSP blocks data: URIs needed for Ghostty WASM loading.
aliases: Ghostty WASM CSP data URI blocked
signals.review_reason: Web terminal is completely unusable due to CSP regression — a previously fixed bug has returned. Blocks the entire web terminal feature. CLI and desktop terminal unaffected but web users lose this capability entirely. Confirmed regression with browser console evidence.

source_issues.title: Regression: Web terminal broken in v1.14.38 - CSP blocks Ghostty WASM (data: URIs)
source_issues.evidence: CSP blocks data:application/wasm;base64 URIs and inline script execution. Previously fixed in #9420/#9700, now regressed. Web terminal completely unusable on v1.14.38.

signals.topic: embedded reflect.Type breaks Go linker dead-code elimination, causing binary bloat
signals.summary: 使用该 SDK 会导致项目无法进行链接器 dead-code elimination（Tree-shaking），从而使最终二进制体积显著增大，影响依赖该 SDK 的所有 Go 项目。
aliases: binary bloat from SDK reflect usage
signals.review_reason: 该 issue 有明确用户影响证据：SDK 的 reflect.Type 嵌入导致所有导入该包的项目无法进行链接器 DCE，直接造成二进制体积膨胀，是已知的多 SDK 共性问题（影响 Steel SDK、openai-go SDK）。用户（Steel/es infra 团队）明确报告了生产影响，非功能请求或安全公告，属于用户可感知的真实痛点。虽然 count=1，但受影响的仓库范围广（涉及 anthropic、openai、steel 三个 SDK），属于跨库系统性问题，优先级定为 P1。

source_issues.title: bug: embedded reflect.Type breaks Go linker dead-code elimination
source_issues.evidence: 用户报告使用该 SDK 导致其项目无法进行 dead code elimination，直接引用了 openai-go 同类问题的 issue（#609），Steel SDK 团队（ofek-frame）也受到影响并主动上报。

signals.topic: Java quickstart documentation is broken — missing classpath setup and non-existent Maven version block new users from running the SDK
signals.summary: The official Java quickstart page instructs users to run `javac QuickStart.java` and `java QuickStart` without any classpath configuration, and references Maven version `2.20.0` which does not exist on Maven Central. Both issues make the quickstart completely non-functional for new users trying to onboard the SDK.
aliases: missing dependency setup in Java quickstart
signals.review_reason: New users trying to onboard the SDK via the official quickstart are completely blocked — the `javac`/`java` commands fail due to missing classpath, and the Maven version is invalid. This is a clear onboarding failure with explicit user impact evidence in the issue report.

source_issues.title: Java quickstart docs: javac/java commands don't work without classpath setup, version 2.20.0 doesn't exist
source_issues.evidence: The `javac` command fails immediately because `QuickStart.java` imports `com.anthropic.*` JARs that `javac` has no knowledge of. The Maven/Gradle snippets reference version `2.20.0`, which returns a 404 from Maven Central. New users cannot complete onboarding.

signals.topic: Structured output schema treats all Java class fields as required regardless of nullability annotations, causing LLM to hallucinate values
signals.summary: When using `StructuredMessageCreateParams.outputConfig(Class)`, the internal schema generator adds every Java class field to the `required` array of the generated JSON Schema, ignoring `@Nullable` annotations and `Optional<T>` types. The LLM is forced to fabricate values (e.g., string 'null', empty string, or dash) to satisfy the schema even when the system prompt instructs it to leave fields empty. This produces incorrect structured output data, a critical quality and reliability issue for production use.
aliases: Structured output schema ignores Java nullability
Structured output LLM hallucination due to incorrect schema
signals.review_reason: The structured output feature produces incorrect data in production — the schema generator ignores standard Java nullability markers (`@Nullable`, `Optional<T>`) and marks every field required, forcing the LLM to hallucinate values. This is a functional defect that directly breaks the output quality of a key SDK feature with no workaround for Java users.

source_issues.title: Structured Output: Java fields are always included in the required array, ignoring nullability markers
source_issues.evidence: All fields in a Java class are added to the `required` array regardless of `@jakarta.annotation.Nullable`, `@JsonProperty(required=false)`, or `Optional<T>` type. The LLM is forced to hallucinate values such as the string 'null', empty string, or dash to satisfy schema constraints. No workaround exists for Java users.

signals.topic: Structured outputs grammar too large — 400 error blocks complex-but-valid JSON schemas
signals.summary: Complex but common JSON schemas (5-level nesting, nullable types, repeated sub-schemas) trigger a 'compiled grammar is too large' 400 error, forcing users to fall back to unreliable prompt-based JSON parsing.
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：用户的生产代码生成服务无法使用 structured outputs，被迫降级到不可靠的 prompt-based JSON，失去了有保障的模式合规性。真实业务逻辑受影响，不是边缘案例。

source_issues.title: Structured outputs: "compiled grammar is too large" error needs better documentation and higher limits for complex schemas
source_issues.evidence: User has a real production code generation service with moderately nested schemas (5 levels, ~50 properties) that cannot use structured outputs. Falls back to prompt-based JSON which sacrifices guaranteed schema compliance. Error: 400 'compiled grammar is too large'.

signals.topic: AsyncAnthropicVertex 在 US/EU 区域返回 404 — 异步端点路径错误
signals.summary: 使用 region='us' 或 region='eu' 时，AsyncAnthropicVertex 发送请求到错误的端点 (us-aiplatform.googleapis.com 而非 aiplatform.us.rep.googleapis.com)，导致 404 错误。同步版本正常。
aliases: async vertex wrong endpoint us eu
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：异步 Vertex AI 在美国和欧盟区域完全不可用，同步方法正常但异步方法 404，是明确的代码 bug。全球使用 Vertex US/EU 区域的异步开发者受影响。

source_issues.title: Async methods NOT working with US/EU regions on Vertex AI - Gets 404 on endpoints
source_issues.evidence: Sync AnthropicVertex (region='us') → correct endpoint aiplatform.us.rep.googleapis.com → works. Async AsyncAnthropicVertex (region='us') → wrong endpoint us-aiplatform.googleapis.com → 404. 2 comments confirm the issue. Closed with no fix noted.

signals.topic: 短命企业令牌无法自动刷新 — 长运行进程频繁遭遇 401 Unauthorized
signals.summary: 企业用户使用 Entra ID/Okta 等短命令牌时，令牌过期后（Entra 约 1 小时）长运行进程立即收到 401。无官方刷新机制，用户需自行编写 12 行 workaround 代码。
signals.review_reason: 企业用户长运行进程反复遭遇 401 认证失败，虽有 workaround 但体验极差，且落后于 OpenAI SDK 的标准做法，阻碍企业采购决策。

source_issues.title: Support Entra ID and other short-lived bearer tokens for enterprise auth
source_issues.evidence: auth_token 在构造时捕获一次，broker 发行的短命令牌过期后 (Entra ~1h) 长运行进程全部 401。无干净刷新方式，需子类化 + 覆盖 property。用户需复制 12 行 workaround。OpenAI SDK 已有此功能（api_key: str | None | Callable[[], str]），Anthropic SDK 落后于竞品。

signals.topic: Admin API 账单接口缺失 resets_on 字段 — 预算自动化每月失效
signals.summary: GET /v1/organizations/{org_id}/usage API 未返回账单周期重置日期，用户需手动硬编码重置日期，每次账单周期开始即失效，自动化工具被迫中断。
signals.review_reason: 自动化账单工具每月静默失效，虽不影响主流程但破坏关键业务自动化，需人工干预。明确的生产影响证据：硬编码日期每月必须手动更新。

source_issues.title: Add resets_on field to Admin API billing response
source_issues.evidence: 账单 API 不返回 resets_on 字段，开发者被迫硬编码 '2026-06-01'。每月账单周期开始时自动化静默失效，必须人工介入修正日期。控制台 UI 已显示该字段，只是 API 未暴露。

signals.topic: 用量限制无预警机制 — 预算耗尽时工作丢失且无任何提示
signals.summary: 用户在使用过程中毫无预警地达到用量限制，session 立即中断，工作成果丢失。开发者无法订阅限额事件，无法在接近限额时自动节流。
aliases: session stops without notice budget exhausted
signals.review_reason: 直接导致用户工作丢失：长调试会话中途突遇限额且无预警，无任何手段预防。是明显的用户体验和成本损失问题。

source_issues.title: Pre-limit usage alerts and webhooks — notify users before session/weekly budgets are exhausted
source_issues.evidence: 用户在长调试会话中途突遇周限额，未保存工作全部丢失。无 webhooks 或 API 可订阅限额事件，自动化工具无法自我节流。无 X-Budget-Remaining-Pct 响应头。

signals.topic: MCP server 单点不可达导致整个请求原子性失败，生产部署脆弱
signals.summary: 当 `mcp_servers` 中任一服务器不可达时（断网、ngrok 抖动、第三方服务宕机），整个 API 请求以 HTTP 400 原子性失败，无 per-server timeout、无 optional 标记、无结构化错误响应。生产环境中注入多个 MCP server 的场景完全不可靠，单个临时故障即阻断完整调用路径。
aliases: MCP server unreachable blocks entire request
signals.review_reason: 这是明确的生产部署阻断场景：用户配置了多个 MCP server（如 fs + search），其中任意一个短暂不可达（ngrok 抖动、第三方宕机、临时隧道中断），整个 API 调用立即以 HTTP 400 失败，健康的服务从未被触达。更关键的是错误消息不含失败服务器名称，用户无法可靠 bisect。此问题直接导致生产工作流不可靠，且在 MCP 生态中是已知痛点（有多篇 2025-2026 行业博文讨论 MCP gateway 模式作为规避手段），符合用户痛点定义的主流程阻断标准。

source_issues.title: API: mcp_servers[].optional flag + structured error for graceful degradation on unreachable injected MCP servers
source_issues.evidence: 单个 MCP server 不可达时整个请求以 400 错误原子性失败；健康的服务从未被触达；生产部署（文件服务器+搜索+领域工具服务器的组合）任何一处抖动即阻断全链路；错误消息不含失败服务器名称，无法机器可读地 bisect 或 retry

signals.topic: Claude Opus 4.6 配合 output_config json_schema 几乎必然返回空 content 数组
signals.summary: 使用 Opus 4.6 模型配合 `output_config.format.json_schema` 时，响应 content 数组几乎总是为空（output_tokens 仅 6），而换成 Opus 4.5 或移除 output_config 则正常。此问题导致依赖结构化输出的主流程完全失效，用户被迫降级模型或放弃结构化输出能力。
aliases: Opus 4.6 json_schema output returns empty content
signals.review_reason: 主流程（结构化输出）功能性失效：用户依赖 output_config json_schema 获取结构化响应，但 Opus 4.6 几乎每次都返回空 content 数组，主流程完全阻断。虽然存在 workaround（降级到 4.5 或开 thinking），但这些方案均非用户原始意图，且会影响延迟和成本。这符合痛点定义中的关键功能不可用标准，虽为单条 issue 但影响直接且明确（主流程失败），优先级 P1。

source_issues.title: Claude Opus 4.6 returns empty content with output_config json_schema
source_issues.evidence: Opus 4.6 + output_config json_schema 几乎每次都返回空 content 数组（output_tokens=6），工作流完全失效；workaround 包括降级到 Opus 4.5 或开启 thinking 模式，但均非理想解决方案

signals.topic: Subprocess stderr 信息被吞没导致长会话崩溃无法诊断
signals.summary: CLI 子进程 stderr 输出和 ProcessError 结构信息在错误传播过程中被完全丢弃，用户只能看到泛化的 'Exception: Command failed with exit code 1' 或硬编码占位符 'Check stderr output for details'，无法定位根因。
aliases: CLI error propagation destroys diagnostic info
