Silent failure where user believes Ruflo is working (configuration shows it loaded) but zero tools are actually available. The 1.8MB/999-file package size vs 30s hardcoded timeout is the root cause.

signals.topic: Hooks defined at marketplace root instead of per-plugin causing zero hooks to load
signals.summary: With ruflo-core installed via claude plugin install, Claude Code loads 3 skills, 1 command, and 3 agents successfully but ZERO hooks load. Hooks are defined at ruflo/.claude-plugin/hooks/hooks.json but Claude Code's plugin loader looks for hooks at <plugin>/hooks/hooks.json (per-plugin). Hooks are supposed to auto-route tasks — when they don't load, Ruflo is reduced to a pile of MCP tools the model demonstrably does not call.
signals.review_reason: P0: Hooks not loading breaks the headline value proposition of the Ruflo plugin. With hooks disabled across experiments, zero benefit was observed from Ruflo — it becomes a pile of MCP tools the model demonstrably does not call.

This is the headline value proposition being broken — hooks are supposed to auto-route tasks automatically.

signals.topic: Windows daemon background process dies immediately due to IPC channel fork tied to parent
signals.summary: On Windows, the daemon child process dies within ~1 second of parent npx wrapper exiting. The IPC channel kept open between parent and child means child.unref() does not close the IPC pipe, so when the npx wrapper exits, Windows tears down the IPC pipe and the forked child exits. Foreground mode works but background daemon is non-functional.
signals.review_reason: Main workflow blocking on Windows: daemon start --background produces a process that immediately dies, making the background daemon functionality unusable on Windows. Clear reproduction steps provided, root cause identified, and local patch demonstrated.

Foreground mode works but background daemon is non-functional.

signals.topic: Zod >= 4.4.0 导致 Amazon Bedrock 所有 Tool Call 全部失败（schema 验证阻断）

aliases: bedrock tool schema zod 4.4 input required
signals.review_reason: count=2，高频影响且主流程阻断。Benchmark：所有通过 Bedrock Converse Stream API 的工具调用均受影响，零例外。用户被迫降级 Zod 到 4.3.x 或使用 patch-package，代价高昂。

source_issues.title: BedrockToolUseSchema rejects valid contentBlockStart events under Zod >= 4.4.0
source_issues.evidence: Every tool call through @ai-sdk/amazon-bedrock fails validation when zod@>=4.4.0 is resolved. AI_TypeValidationError thrown on first event of every tool call with path: contentBlockStart.start.toolUse.input (expected nonoptional, received undefined). No version of @ai-sdk/amazon-bedrock survives zod@>=4.4.0.

source_issues.title: fix(amazon-bedrock): BedrockToolUseSchema input field breaks with zod@4.4.x
source_issues.evidence: Same root cause as #14892. BedrockToolUseSchema defines input: z.unknown() which now requires the key under Zod v4.4.0+. Error: expected nonoptional, received undefined. Fix: change to z.unknown().optional().

res.status is not a function after Vercel Rust runtime deploy

signals.topic: Claude Code agent conversation stalls when sub-agents / teammates send messages (no auto-turn triggered)

signals.topic: Claude Code agent responses become hidden / out-of-sync after API rate limit reset
signals.summary: After hitting the Claude API rate limit and waiting for the reset, the agent panel enters a broken state where responses are offset by one turn. Response to query N only appears after query N+1 is sent, creating a persistent offset that makes the agent unusable without restarting Zed.
aliases: Claude Code rate limit response offset
agent turn offset after rate limit
signals.review_reason: Claude Code agent becomes permanently unusable after a rate limit event without manual restart. Responses are offset by one turn indefinitely, making the agent unreliable. Workaround of restarting Zed is unacceptable for active sessions.

source_issues.title: Claude Code agent responses become hidden/out-of-sync after rate limit reset
source_issues.evidence: After rate limit reset, responses are shifted by one turn. Response to query N only renders when query N+1 is sent. Workaround: restart Zed. OS: Ubuntu 24.04.4, Zed 1.0.1. Only open issue.

signals.topic: pnpm monorepo: file path incorrectly rewritten to node_modules after save, breaking the workspace
signals.summary: In pnpm monorepos, saving a file causes its path to be rewritten to a node_modules path. The editor buffer then points to the wrong location, causing TS errors and a broken workspace. This is a recent regression.
signals.review_reason: File save operation rewrites the buffer's path to node_modules in pnpm monorepos, corrupting the workspace state and making the editor unusable. This is a recent regression that blocks file editing in pnpm monorepos, a common production setup.

source_issues.title: file path changed to inside node_modules in pnpm monorepo
source_issues.evidence: Saving a file in a pnpm monorepo rewrites its path to node_modules/.pnpm/. Editor buffer then references wrong location. Everything turns red with TS errors. Recent regression (worked a week ago). OS: macOS 15.7.3, Zed 1.0.1. Only open issue.
